name: Google Photos → Content Director
notes:
Watches two Google Photos albums every 2 hours. When new videos are found, auto-generates captions for all 4 platforms and queues them as drafts in AICC. Sends Kareesa an email notification.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ONE-TIME SETUP (read before importing)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

STEP 1 — Create Google Photos albums
  In Google Photos, create two albums:
  • "GymnastDiva Content"  ← upload Iyah's gymnastics videos here
  • "Real Estate Content"  ← upload neighborhood tour videos here

STEP 2 — Get your album IDs
  Open each album in Google Photos → copy the ID from the URL:
  https://photos.google.com/album/ALBUM_ID_IS_HERE

STEP 3 — Paste album IDs into this workflow
  • "Get GymnastDiva Videos" node → replace REPLACE_WITH_GYMNAST_ALBUM_ID
  • "Get Real Estate Videos" node → replace REPLACE_WITH_RE_ALBUM_ID

STEP 4 — Create Google Photos OAuth2 credential in n8n
  1. Go to n8n → Credentials → New → Google OAuth2 API
  2. Add scope: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/photoslibrary.readonly
  3. Use the same Client ID and Secret as your Gmail credential
     (you need to add the Photos Library API in Google Cloud Console first)
  4. Name it "Google Photos" and connect your account
  5. Update this credential in the two HTTP Request nodes (Get GymnastDiva Videos, Get Real Estate Videos)

STEP 5 — Update the Gmail credential
  Set "Send Notification" node to use your cham4547@gmail.com credential

STEP 6 — Enable Photos Library API in Google Cloud
  Go to console.cloud.google.com → APIs & Services → Enable APIs
  Search for "Photos Library API" → Enable it

STEP 7 — Test and activate
  Run manually first. After confirming it works, toggle Active ON.
